visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair, wearing a white button-down shirt tied at the waist and tan pants, holds a black RODE microphone and speaks excitedly to the camera. He stands in a brightly lit mall interior in front of various retail signage. (2) The shot shifts to a wide angle showing the RMK cosmetics counter, a sleek white and glass structure with illuminated product displays and a digital advertisement of a model. (3) The man holds a beige concealer pen close to the lens. (4) A female makeup artist with a ponytail and a tan outfit appears, waving at the camera with a bright smile. (5) A close-up shows the concealer being swatched on the back of a hand, followed by the artist applying it to the man's under-eye area with her fingers. (6) The camera focuses on a bottle of primer and then on hands dispensing and rubbing the white liquid into skin. (7) A white square setting powder compact is opened; the artist uses a small brush to apply powder to the man's cheek and nose area. (8) A top-down shot displays rows of lipsticks on a shelf. The artist swatches three distinct shades (orange, pink, reddish-brown) on her forearm. (9) The man and artist stand together, gesturing and waving at the camera for the closing shot.
